verses.text: As people became more and more numerous across the earth, daughters were born to them.
God's sons saw that human daughters were beautiful, so they took as wives whichever women they wanted.
Yahweh said, "My Spirit will not keep contending with human beings forever, because they are mortal. Their days will be 120 years."
The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and afterward too, when God's sons had children with human daughters. Their children became the mighty heroes of old, famous people from long ago.
Yahweh saw that human evil had grown huge on the earth, and that every plan and thought in their hearts kept turning toward evil all the time.
Yahweh regretted making human beings on earth, and it deeply grieved his heart.
Yahweh said, "I will wipe from the earth the human beings I created—people, livestock, creatures that crawl, and birds in the sky—because I regret making them."
But Noah found favor with Yahweh.
This is Noah's family story: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. He walked with God.
Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
The earth was corrupt in God's sight and was filled with violence.
God looked at the earth and saw that it was corrupt. Everyone had ruined their way of living on earth.
God said to Noah, "I will bring all living creatures to an end, because the earth is filled with violence because of them. I am about to destroy them along with the earth.
Build an ark from gopher wood. Make rooms inside it, and coat it inside and outside with pitch.
Build it this way: the ark must be 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.
Make a roof for the ark and leave an opening one cubit below its top. Put a door in its side. Build a lower deck, a second deck, and a third deck.
I am going to bring floodwaters over the earth to destroy every living creature that breathes under the sky. Everything on earth will die.
But I will establish my covenant with you. You, your sons, your wife, and your sons' wives will enter the ark.
Bring two of every kind of living creature into the ark to keep them alive with you. Bring one male and one female of each kind.
Two of every kind of bird, livestock, and creature that crawls on the ground will come to you so they can stay alive.
Take every kind of food people and animals eat, and store it for you and them."
Noah did everything exactly as God commanded him.
